source_note: 41 everyday situational duas (sleep, wudu, entering/leaving the home/masjid, travel, meals, Istikhara, Qunoot, etc.). Topic list, English titles, and hadith/Quran references were carried over from a user-supplied PDF (author: Haque Ashanul) — but that PDF's Arabic did not extract as usable text (glyph-run scrambling, a known issue with this class of PDF), so it was not copied. The Arabic here was independently reconstructed from the standard hadith wording for each dua (matching the cited source — Sahih al-Bukhari, Sahih Muslim, Abu Dawud, at-Tirmidhi, Ibn Majah, or the cited Quran verse), the same wording found identically across published hadith collections; these are 1,400-year-old transmitted texts, not any one compiler's creative work. English translations here are original, not copied from the source PDF. Not yet reviewed by a scholar or the mosque community — verify before treating as final.

parts.arabic: بِاسْمِكَ اللَّهُمَّ أَمُوتُ وَأَحْيَا
parts.translation: In Your name, O Allah, I die and I live.

parts.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَحْيَانَا بَعْدَ مَا أَمَاتَنَا وَإِلَيْهِ النُّشُورُ
parts.translation: Praise be to Allah, who gave us life after having caused us to die, and unto Him is the resurrection.

parts.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْخُبُثِ وَالْخَبَائِثِ
parts.translation: In the name of Allah. O Allah, I seek refuge in You from male and female devils.

duas.note: A shorter "Ghufranak" (Your forgiveness, I ask) is also authentically reported (Abu Dawud, at-Tirmidhi) and may be used instead.

parts.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَذْهَبَ عَنِّي الْأَذَى وَعَافَانِي
parts.translation: Praise be to Allah, who removed discomfort from me and gave me ease.

duas.reference: Abu Dawud, Ibn Majah, Imam Ahmad

parts.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ
parts.translation: In the name of Allah, the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.

duas.note: Also recommended as dhikr throughout the day.

parts.arabic: أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ
parts.translation: I bear witness that there is no god but Allah, alone, without partner, and I bear witness that Muhammad is His servant and messenger.

parts.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، وَالصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ، اللَّهُمَّ افْتَحْ لِي أَبْوَابَ رَحْمَتِكَ
parts.translation: In the name of Allah, and peace and blessings be upon the Messenger of Allah. O Allah, open the doors of Your mercy for me.

parts.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، وَالصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ
parts.translation: In the name of Allah, and peace and blessings be upon the Messenger of Allah. O Allah, I ask You of Your bounty.

duas.note: Also recommended before starting anything.

parts.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ
parts.translation: In the name of Allah.

duas.note: Also recommended before starting anything.

parts.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ فِي أَوَّلِهِ وَآخِرِهِ
parts.translation: In the name of Allah, at the beginning and end of it.

duas.reference: Dua 1: at-Tirmidhi, Abu Dawud, Ibn Majah · Dua 2: Ibn Majah, Abu Dawud, at-Tirmidhi · Dua 3: at-Tirmidhi

parts.label: Dua 1
parts.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَطْعَمَنِي هَٰذَا وَرَزَقَنِيهِ مِنْ غَيْرِ حَوْلٍ مِنِّي وَلَا قُوَّةٍ
parts.translation: Praise be to Allah who fed me this and provided it for me without any power or ability on my part.

parts.label: Dua 2
parts.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَطْعَمَنَا وَسَقَانَا وَجَعَلَنَا مُسْلِمِينَ
parts.translation: Praise be to Allah who fed us and gave us drink and made us Muslims.

parts.label: Dua 3
parts.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَنَا فِيهِ وَأَطْعِمْنَا خَيْرًا مِنْهُ
parts.translation: O Allah, bless it for us and feed us with something better than it.

duas.note: Recited in the final Tashahhud, before ending the prayer.

parts.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ، وَمِنْ عَذَابِ جَهَنَّمَ، وَمِنْ فِتْنَةِ الْمَحْيَا وَالْمَمَاتِ، وَمِنْ شَرِّ فِتْنَةِ الْمَسِيحِ الدَّجَّالِ
parts.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the punishment of the grave, from the punishment of Hell, from the trials of life and death, and from the evil of the trial of the False Messiah.

duas.note: Also recommended when leaving in any vehicle — car, bus, train, plane, etc.

parts.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى اللَّهِ، وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
parts.translation: In the name of Allah, I place my trust in Allah; there is no might nor power except with Allah.

duas.note: Followed by greeting those present with "As-salamu alaykum."

parts.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَلَجْنَا، وَبِسْمِ اللَّهِ خَرَجْنَا، وَعَلَى رَبِّنَا تَوَكَّلْنَا
parts.translation: In the name of Allah we enter, in the name of Allah we leave, and upon our Lord we depend.

duas.note: Also recommended for any journey — car, bus, train, plane, etc.

parts.arabic: سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَٰذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ، وَإِنَّا إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا لَمُنْقَلِبُونَ
parts.translation: Glory to Him who has subjected this to us, for we could never have accomplished it by ourselves. And indeed, to our Lord we will surely return.

parts.arabic: سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَٰذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ، وَإِنَّا إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا لَمُنْقَلِبُونَ
parts.translation: Glory to Him who has subjected this to us, for we could never have accomplished it by ourselves. And indeed, to our Lord we will surely return.

parts.arabic: آيِبُونَ تَائِبُونَ عَابِدُونَ لِرَبِّنَا حَامِدُونَ
parts.translation: We return, repentant, worshipping, and praising our Lord.

duas.note: Also said on any occasion to thank Allah.

parts.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ
parts.translation: All praise is for Allah.

parts.arabic: يَرْحَمُكَ اللَّهُ
parts.translation: May Allah have mercy on you.

parts.arabic: يَهْدِيكُمُ اللَّهُ وَيُصْلِحُ بَالَكُمْ
parts.translation: May Allah guide you and set your affairs right.

parts.arabic: لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، يُحْيِي وَيُمِيتُ وَهُوَ حَيٌّ لَا يَمُوتُ، بِيَدِهِ الْخَيْرُ، وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
parts.translation: There is no god but Allah, alone, without partner. His is the dominion and His is the praise. He gives life and causes death, and He is living and does not die. In His hand is all good, and He is over all things omnipotent.

parts.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، اللَّهُمَّ جَنِّبْنَا الشَّيْطَانَ، وَجَنِّبِ الشَّيْطَانَ مَا رَزَقْتَنَا
parts.translation: In the name of Allah. O Allah, keep Satan away from us, and keep Satan away from what You bless us with.

parts.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ هَٰذِهِ الدَّعْوَةِ التَّامَّةِ، وَالصَّلَاةِ الْقَائِمَةِ، آتِ مُحَمَّدًا الْوَسِيلَةَ وَالْفَضِيلَةَ، وَابْعَثْهُ مَقَامًا مَحْمُودًا الَّذِي وَعَدْتَهُ، إِنَّكَ لَا تُخْلِفُ الْمِيعَادَ
parts.translation: O Allah, Lord of this perfect call and of the prayer to be established, grant Muhammad the intercession and favour, and raise him to the praiseworthy station You promised him. Indeed, You do not fail in Your promise.

parts.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِحَيِّنَا وَمَيِّتِنَا، وَشَاهِدِنَا وَغَائِبِنَا، وَصَغِيرِنَا وَكَبِيرِنَا، وَذَكَرِنَا وَأُنْثَانَا، اللَّهُمَّ مَنْ أَحْيَيْتَهُ مِنَّا فَأَحْيِهِ عَلَى الْإِسْلَامِ، وَمَنْ تَوَفَّيْتَهُ مِنَّا فَتَوَفَّهُ عَلَى الْإِيمَانِ، اللَّهُمَّ لَا تَحْرِمْنَا أَجْرَهُ وَلَا تُضِلَّنَا بَعْدَهُ
parts.translation: O Allah, forgive our living and our dead, those present and those absent, our young and our old, our males and our females. O Allah, whoever among us You keep alive, let him live upon Islam, and whoever among us You take, let him die upon faith. O Allah, do not deprive us of his reward, and do not let us go astray after him.

duas.note: Recommended as dhikr, to purify the heart, at any time.

parts.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ، سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ
parts.translation: Glory be to Allah and praise Him; glory be to Allah, the Magnificent.

duas.note: Also recommended as dhikr throughout the day, and in Ramadan.

parts.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّكَ عَفُوٌّ تُحِبُّ الْعَفْوَ فَاعْفُ عَنِّي
parts.translation: O Allah, You are Most Forgiving and love forgiveness, so forgive me.

duas.note: Also recommended as dhikr throughout the day.

parts.arabic: لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
parts.translation: There is no might nor power except with Allah.

duas.note: Recommended as dhikr at any time, to purify the heart.

parts.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، وَلَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ، وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ
parts.translation: Glory be to Allah, praise be to Allah, there is no god but Allah, and Allah is the Greatest.

duas.note: The dua of Prophet Yunus (Jonah), peace be upon him. Also recommended as dhikr throughout the day.

parts.arabic: لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّي كُنْتُ مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ
parts.translation: There is no god but You, glory be to You; indeed, I was among the wrongdoers.

duas.note: Also recommended as dhikr throughout the day.

parts.arabic: حَسْبُنَا اللَّهُ وَنِعْمَ الْوَكِيلُ
parts.translation: Allah is sufficient for us, and He is the best disposer of affairs.

duas.note: Also recommended in Sujud, Ruku, Tashahhud, and after Fajr and Maghrib.

parts.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَجِرْنِي مِنَ النَّارِ
parts.translation: O Allah, save me from the Fire.

duas.note: Also recommended in Tashahhud and general Adhkar.

parts.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ أَنْ أُشْرِكَ بِكَ شَيْئًا أَعْلَمُهُ، وَأَسْتَغْفِرُكَ لِمَا لَا أَعْلَمُ
parts.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from knowingly associating anything with You, and I seek Your forgiveness for what I do not know.

duas.note: Also recommended for Ruqyah.

parts.arabic: أُعِيذُكُمَا بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّةِ، مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْطَانٍ وَهَامَّةٍ، وَمِنْ كُلِّ عَيْنٍ لَامَّةٍ
parts.translation: I seek protection for you both in the perfect words of Allah, from every devil and poisonous creature, and from every harmful, envious eye.

parts.label: Quran 14:41
parts.arabic: رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَلِوَالِدَيَّ وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ يَوْمَ يَقُومُ الْحِسَابُ
parts.translation: Our Lord, forgive me and my parents and the believers, the Day the reckoning is established.

parts.label: Quran 17:24
parts.arabic: رَبِّ ارْحَمْهُمَا كَمَا رَبَّيَانِي صَغِيرًا
parts.translation: My Lord, have mercy upon them as they raised me when I was small.

parts.arabic: ذَهَبَ الظَّمَأُ، وَابْتَلَّتِ الْعُرُوقُ، وَثَبَتَ الْأَجْرُ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ
parts.translation: The thirst is gone, the veins are moistened, and the reward is confirmed, if Allah wills.

parts.arabic: لَا بَأْسَ، طَهُورٌ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ
parts.translation: No harm, it will be a purification, if Allah wills.

parts.arabic: أَسْأَلُ اللَّهَ الْعَظِيمَ رَبَّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ أَنْ يَشْفِيَكَ
parts.translation: I ask Allah the Magnificent, Lord of the Magnificent Throne, to heal you.

duas.note: Also recommended in Dua and Tashahhud.

parts.arabic: أَذْهِبِ الْبَأْسَ رَبَّ النَّاسِ، اشْفِ وَأَنْتَ الشَّافِي، لَا شِفَاءَ إِلَّا شِفَاؤُكَ، شِفَاءً لَا يُغَادِرُ سَقَمًا
parts.translation: Remove the affliction, Lord of mankind, and heal — You are the Healer, there is no healing but Your healing — a healing that leaves no illness.

parts.arabic: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ أَهْلَ الدِّيَارِ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُسْلِمِينَ، وَإِنَّا إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ بِكُمْ لَاحِقُونَ، نَسْأَلُ اللَّهَ لَنَا وَلَكُمُ الْعَافِيَةَ
parts.translation: Peace be upon you, inhabitants of this abode, among the believers and Muslims. We shall, if Allah wills, join you. We ask Allah for well-being, for us and for you.

duas.note: Also recommended for troublesome affairs, exams, and tests.

parts.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَا سَهْلَ إِلَّا مَا جَعَلْتَهُ سَهْلًا، وَأَنْتَ تَجْعَلُ الْحَزْنَ إِذَا شِئْتَ سَهْلًا
parts.translation: O Allah, nothing is easy except what You make easy, and You make the difficult easy, if You wish.

duas.note: Recited after two voluntary rak'ahs when seeking Allah's guidance on a decision — name the specific matter in place of "this matter."

parts.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْتَخِيرُكَ بِعِلْمِكَ، وَأَسْتَقْدِرُكَ بِقُدْرَتِكَ، وَأَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ الْعَظِيمِ، فَإِنَّكَ تَقْدِرُ وَلَا أَقْدِرُ، وَتَعْلَمُ وَلَا أَعْلَمُ، وَأَنْتَ عَلَّامُ الْغُيُوبِ. اللَّهُمَّ إِنْ كُنْتَ تَعْلَمُ أَنَّ هَٰذَا الْأَمْرَ خَيْرٌ لِي فِي دِينِي وَمَعَاشِي وَعَاقِبَةِ أَمْرِي، فَاقْدُرْهُ لِي وَيَسِّرْهُ لِي، ثُمَّ بَارِكْ لِي فِيهِ. وَإِنْ كُنْتَ تَعْلَمُ أَنَّ هَٰذَا الْأَمْرَ شَرٌّ لِي فِي دِينِي وَمَعَاشِي وَعَاقِبَةِ أَمْرِي، فَاصْرِفْهُ عَنِّي وَاصْرِفْنِي عَنْهُ، وَاقْدُرْ لِيَ الْخَيْرَ حَيْثُ كَانَ، ثُمَّ أَرْضِنِي بِهِ
parts.translation: O Allah, I seek Your guidance by virtue of Your knowledge, and I seek ability by virtue of Your power, and I ask You of Your immense bounty. You have power and I have none; You know and I do not; You are the Knower of the unseen. O Allah, if You know this matter to be good for me in my religion, my livelihood, and the outcome of my affairs, then decree it for me, make it easy for me, and bless it for me. And if You know this matter to be bad for me in my religion, my livelihood, and the outcome of my affairs, then turn it away from me and turn me away from it, and decree for me what is good wherever it may be, and make me content with it.

duas.reference: Qunoot 1: Abu Dawud, at-Tirmidhi, an-Nasa'i · Qunoot 2: al-Bayhaqi
duas.note: Recited in Witr prayer.

parts.label: Qunoot 1
parts.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اهْدِنِي فِيمَنْ هَدَيْتَ، وَعَافِنِي فِيمَنْ عَافَيْتَ، وَتَوَلَّنِي فِيمَنْ تَوَلَّيْتَ، وَبَارِكْ لِي فِيمَا أَعْطَيْتَ، وَقِنِي شَرَّ مَا قَضَيْتَ، فَإِنَّكَ تَقْضِي وَلَا يُقْضَى عَلَيْكَ، وَإِنَّهُ لَا يَذِلُّ مَنْ وَالَيْتَ، وَلَا يَعِزُّ مَنْ عَادَيْتَ، تَبَارَكْتَ رَبَّنَا وَتَعَالَيْتَ
parts.translation: O Allah, guide me among those You have guided, grant me well-being among those You have granted well-being, take care of me among those You have taken care of, bless what You have given me, and protect me from the evil You have decreed. Truly You decree and none decrees over You; he whom You befriend is not humbled, and he whom You oppose is not honoured. Blessed are You, our Lord, and Exalted.

parts.label: Qunoot 2
parts.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَسْتَعِينُكَ وَنَسْتَغْفِرُكَ وَنُؤْمِنُ بِكَ وَنَتَوَكَّلُ عَلَيْكَ، وَنُثْنِي عَلَيْكَ الْخَيْرَ كُلَّهُ، نَشْكُرُكَ وَلَا نَكْفُرُكَ، وَنَخْلَعُ وَنَتْرُكُ مَنْ يَفْجُرُكَ. اللَّهُمَّ إِيَّاكَ نَعْبُدُ، وَلَكَ نُصَلِّي وَنَسْجُدُ، وَإِلَيْكَ نَسْعَى وَنَحْفِدُ، نَرْجُو رَحْمَتَكَ وَنَخْشَى عَذَابَكَ الْجِدَّ، إِنَّ عَذَابَكَ بِالْكُفَّارِ مُلْحِقٌ
parts.translation: O Allah, we seek Your help, ask Your forgiveness, believe in You, and rely upon You. We praise You with all good, we thank You and are not ungrateful to You, and we cast off and forsake whoever disobeys You. O Allah, You alone we worship, and to You we pray and prostrate, and to You we hasten and strive; we hope for Your mercy and fear Your serious punishment — indeed, Your punishment overtakes the disbelievers.
